they had purchased either clothing and apparel or leisure items. Travel products ranked third, followed by footwear and accessories, with 74 and 73 percent of respondents, respectively. Read more

Payment preferences

Description: Roughly six out of 10 e-commerce vendors in Spain offer buy now, pay later on their website come 2024. This is according to a survey held in early 2024, asking e-commerce professionals on which payment methods they are offering. Noticeable for Spain
